data.name: PolyCrime
data.detailed_description:
🕹️ About the Game

PolyCrime is an open-city crime simulation where you start small and slowly build your own mafia empire. Grow and sell drugs, make deals on the streets, cut protection deals with gangs, dodge police patrols and protect your money from darkweb attacks.

You’re just a small fish at the beginning  sleeping in a cheap room, growing your first plants and testing the streets. As you earn more, your name spreads. Gangs start to notice you, NPCs remember how you treated them, and one mistake can cost you your stash, your money or your freedom.

WHAT’S IN THE GAME RIGHT NOW (EARLY ACCESS)

  • Explore a low-poly city with different districts and a day/night cycle.

  • Grow and harvest weed, then package it and sell it to NPCs on the street.

  • Negotiate prices and risk that some NPCs might rat you out to the police.

  • Trade with other players through an online marketplace – buy and sell drugs, items and resources player-to-player.

  • Break into apartments and houses to steal cash and valuable loot if you’re willing to take the risk. ( December update )

  • Deal with gangs: pay protection to sell safely on their turf or ignore them and face the consequences.

  • Avoid police patrols, hide your illegal stuff and risk getting arrested if you push it too far.

  • Use the in-game computer and darkweb to launch attacks against other players’ bank accounts and defend your own money.

  • Play multiplayer blackjack in the casino and gamble your dirty (or clean) money against other players.

  • Build up your reputation and income over time, unlock better gear and expand your operation step by step.

ROADMAP – WHERE WE’RE TAKING POLYCRIME

During Early Access we plan to:

  • Expand the city with new locations, interiors and activities.

  • Deepen gang and police AI, including patrols, territory and reactions to your actions.

  • Add more progression systems (stash upgrades, businesses, new ways to launder money).

  • Improve darkweb tools and add more ways to attack and defend player wealth.

  • Add more legal/illegal side activities that support your criminal empire.

  • Introduce luxury penthouses in the casino that you can purchase.

  • Add a multi-stage casino vault heist.

  • Implement a weapon crafting system so you can build, upgrade and customize your own firepower.

  • Expand drug distribution through airport smuggling routes and new high-risk, high-reward delivery options.

Our goal is a deep, systemic crime sim where every deal, every favour and every betrayal matters – and where the community helps steer which systems we expand first.

💡 Summary

PolyCrime offers a deep, replayable simulation of city crime, survival, and strategy. With dynamic systems, emergent gameplay, and multiple progression paths — legal or illegal — your story is yours to write.

Will you become a feared kingpin, a respected entrepreneur, or just another name lost to the streets?

We want to steer the game in the direction our community chooses. On our Discord, you can already submit ideas you’re missing in games or haven’t seen anywhere else.

What the community votes for will be added to the game. Join in, vote, and shape the future of PolyCrime.

⚠️ Disclaimer

FoxGameDev Studio does not endorse or promote real-life violence, crime, drug use, or illegal behavior.

All content is fictional and intended for mature, responsible audiences.

The game encourages player choice and freedom within a stylized simulation world.

data.short_description: Build a crime empire in a living city. Grow and sell drugs, work with or against gangs, dodge the police and use the darkweb to attack other players’ bank accounts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains adult themes including drug production, trafficking, and usage. It features strong language, criminal activities such as illegal trade and gun violence, and depictions of police chases and arrests. Some NPCs may react to drug deals by alerting authorities.

Player choices may include morally ambiguous or illegal actions, such as bribery, money laundering, and gang warfare.

There are no depictions of sexual content, rape, or non-consensual acts.
